mainEntity.name: What types of car insurance are mandatory in Texas?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Texas, drivers must have liability insurance to cover damages or injuries they may cause in an accident. The minimum liability coverage required is $30,000 per person for bodily injury, $60,000 per accident for bodily injury, and $25,000 per accident for property damage.

mainEntity.name: Can I legally drive without car insurance in Texas?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, it is illegal to drive without car insurance in Texas. Drivers must have at least the minimum liability coverage required by law.

mainEntity.name: What factors affect the cost of car insurance in Texas?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of car insurance in Texas is affected by several factors, including age, gender, driving record, type of vehicle, location, and coverage limits.

mainEntity.name: Does car insurance in Texas cover rental cars?

acceptedAnswer.text: Car insurance policies in Texas may offer coverage for rental cars, but it’s important to check with your insurance company to make sure. Some credit cards may also provide rental car insurance coverage.
